(() => { const w = document.querySelector('[data-wifi]'); const b = w.getBBox(); return { n: w.children.length, box: [b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height].map(Math.round), op: [...w.children].map((c) => c.style.opacity) }; })()

(() => { const w = document.querySelector('[data-wifi]'); const b = w.getBBox(); const c = document.querySelector('[data-chirp]'); return { n: w.children.length, box: [b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height].map(Math.round), chirps: c.children.length }; })()
